exports.kind: three variants × six poses contact sheet

observations: The modest cowl removes the separate lip and carries one cream contour from hood into shoulder while keeping the torso and mitten tabs readable.
The broad canopy creates the clearest connected shoulder silhouette; its lower edge partly occludes arm and mitten cues, especially in crouch, push and settle.
All variants preserve the same recognizable face, seed, boots, palette and pose data. This comparison does not establish final proportions or production animation.

verification.playPause: advanced through poses; paused frame stable over 500ms
verification.reducedMotion: Chromium emulation opened paused on Settle
verification.visualSheetReview: All 18 poses fit in labeled cells; neutral feet align to ground marks.

limitations: Authored art-direction comparison, not a measured preference test.
Proposed discrete poses and timing are not source animation or production timing.
No conclusions about physical dimensions or manufacturing behavior.
coordinatorReview: Broad canopy is a silhouette experiment, not a final winner: scalloped edge dominates and partly hides mitten gestures. Modest cowl preserves more work-pose cues.
